## What does this PR propose?

Briefly explain the change and the problem it addresses. All parts of the current RFC are open to improvement.

## Type of contribution

- [ ] Documentation or architecture change
- [ ] Experiment / proof-of-concept
- [ ] Code, tests or refactor
- [ ] Game integration or variant
- [ ] Governance or licensing proposal
- [ ] Other

## What have you verified?

Describe tests run, results observed, and what remains untested. A draft/experimental PR is welcome.

## Alternatives and compatibility

What else did you consider? Does this affect the shared local/online Agent API, game rules, existing integrations or backward compatibility?

## AI assistance and provenance

Was AI used to prepare the contribution? How? Which outputs did you personally verify? Are any code or assets copied from third-party sources, and under what license?

## Contributor rights

- [ ] I have the rights needed to submit the material and have identified any third-party components.
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), including the current licensing limitations.
- [ ] I understand that a code PR can be reviewed before any necessary contributor rights agreement is completed, and that a merge is not guaranteed.

## What feedback would help?

Questions, uncertainties and areas where you want a second opinion.
